How fast is the development process with Node.js?
responses: Node.js is an incredibly fast, open-source JavaScript runtime environment built on Chrome's V8 engine. While technically not a framework, it uses a non-blocking, single-threaded event loop to handle requests asynchronously. Using JavaScript for both the frontend and backend significantly accelerates the development process. It also utilizes NPM, the world's largest software registry.
